text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's call it a day!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... so much...!
Phew—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my pace control
has become considerably more precise.
choice_data_list: Looks like we can counter that speed now.
Looks like we'll be able to match that speed now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To keep Ai-san from showing off her speed,
I'll turn this into a battle of positioning technique and stamina...!
"The Oaks is 2400m long. It's a distance that forces even those proud of their blazing speed to manage their pace."
Almond Eye's speed was certainly a threat, but she wouldn't be able to unleash it fully this time. Our plan was to seize that opening and claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I will not let my guard down
and show you a decisive victory.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Just watch... Since the Oka Sho, I've gotten even stronger...!)

As the Oaks draws near,
Lucky Lilac's intensity continues to grow.
No doubt spurred on by the presence of a powerful rival.
choice_data_list: (I need to fire myself up more, too.)
(I need to get myself more fired up, too.)

text_block_list.text:
In order to be worthy of standing beside her,
the one destined to become the Queen of the Oaks,
the time had come to set a certain plan into motion.
—And then, the day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks) arrived.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It's been a while since Trainer said they were going to change.
I wonder what's up? That's unusual—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back.
You took quite a while, did something—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer?!
What's with that outfit...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Such sharp and gorgeous clothes...! What is this, like you're attending a ceremony or something—
choice_data_list: I've got myself all fired up!

text_block_list.text:
"I prepared a brand-new custom outfit for today
and groomed myself to the highest standard of my life.
First of all, it looks like I managed to surprise her...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It caught me a bit off guard since it was so sudden,
but it looks wonderful on you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, is that tie pin by any chance... It's small, but does it have an engraving of a lilac on it?"
choice_data_list: Yeah! I've been really particular about a lot of other things too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...That brooch.
It's modeled after a lilac, isn't it?"
choice_data_list: Yeah! I've been really particular about a lot of other things too.

text_block_list.text:
Standing beside her, I incorporated various touches to make her shine even more.
I felt a little happy when she noticed.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they're really amazing.
...Standing next to them makes even me nervous.
choice_data_list: What!? T-That's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding.
I think you look very cool and dependable.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer went all out and got everything ready for me.
I've gotta live up to it, too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I'm off to claim the crown of oaks.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I will defeat Ai-san, and every other Umamusume,
and I will become the Queen."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"So, please wait for me in the winner's circle
lookin' all sharp and cool."
choice_data_list: ……You're not just spacing out, are you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's just the usual for you!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Looks like all the runners have gathered.
Everyone's looking in top form—)

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"An announcement for all Umamusume
running in the Oaks
and their trainers."

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"This race serves as the judged event for this year's URA Best Dressed Award.
We will now announce the results of the judging."
The "URA Best Dresser Award" evaluates and honors the style and coordination of an Umamusume's racing outfit alongside her Trainer's attire.

"It was an event held occasionally for specific races,
but I had completely forgotten that the 'Oaks'
was the target this time around...!"

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text: "Now, please direct your attention to the screen!"

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"And the winner of this year's
URA Best Dressed Award is—"

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac-san,
and her Trainer!!"
(Oooooooh...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text: "They gave high marks particularly to how the Trainer's outfit was carefully coordinated to stand alongside Lucky Lilac!"
choice_data_list: (Th-They actually noticed all the details I obsessed over...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Let's look forward to their stellar performances today!
That concludes the announcement for the URA Dresser Award!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: This is a real good sign—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations, Lala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Almond Eye-san.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Impressive as always. You never leave an opening, even in situations like this. I truly respect that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still, the one who's gonna win today is me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Oka Sho, I've retrained myself without a shred of compromise...!
All to beat the you of today, right here at 2400m!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you!
The strongest running I'm capable of right now!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...You're full of spirit today too, huh.
But there are things you can't overcome with spirit alone.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Get a good taste of the fact that my running isn't just for show.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu...! That's the spirit!
